stories.headline: China Blocks Meta's $2B Acquisition of AI Startup Manus, Orders Deal Unwound

key_facts.fact: China's NDRC ordered Meta to unwind its $2 billion-plus acquisition of agentic AI startup Manus, citing violations of export controls and national security regulations.
key_facts.excerpt: China's top economic planner, the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), ordered both companies to cancel the transaction immediately. The ruling follows a months-long investigation into whether the deal violated China's strict export controls and national security regulations.

key_facts.fact: Manus became a sensation in early 2025 after releasing what it called the world's first 'general AI agent'; its core technology was developed by teams in Beijing and Wuhan before the company moved operations to Singapore.
key_facts.excerpt: Manus became a tech sensation in early 2025 after releasing what it called the world's first 'general AI agent'... While Manus is officially registered in Singapore, its roots are firmly in mainland China. The company's core technology was developed by teams in Beijing and Wuhan.

key_facts.fact: Manus co-founders were summoned to meetings with Chinese officials in March and have since been barred from leaving the country.
key_facts.excerpt: Previous reports from the Financial Times and The New York Times claimed that the co-founders of Manus were summoned to meetings with Chinese officials in March and have since been barred from leaving the country.

key_facts.fact: Beijing feared the move was a blueprint for 'technology leakage,' where homegrown Chinese AI innovation is quietly moved abroad to be acquired by American companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Beijing's regulators reportedly feared this move was a blueprint for 'technology leakage,' where homegrown Chinese innovation is quietly moved abroad to be acquired by American giants like Meta.

key_facts.fact: The block coincides with the White House issuing directives accusing China of running 'industrial-scale' efforts to steal US AI technology.
key_facts.excerpt: The White House has issued an urgent directive to government agencies, accusing China of running a massive, state-sponsored campaign to steal the American artificial intelligence (AI) technology.

stories.headline: OpenAI Publishes Five-Principle Framework for AGI, Altman Concedes Company's Larger Scale

key_facts.fact: OpenAI published a five-principle framework for AGI development on Sunday: democratization, empowerment, universal prosperity, resilience, and adaptability.
key_facts.excerpt: The post titled 'Our Principles' devotes a paragraph to each. Democratization comes first... Empowerment... Universal prosperity... Resilience pledges collaboration with companies, governments... Adaptability sits last.

key_facts.fact: Altman concedes OpenAI is 'materially larger' than at the time of the 2018 Charter and acknowledges scenarios where the company 'may have to trade off some empowerment for more resilience.'
key_facts.excerpt: He writes that OpenAI is materially larger than at the time of the 2018 Charter and acknowledges scenarios in which the company 'may have to trade off some empowerment for more resilience.' An unusual concession.

key_facts.fact: The framework is OpenAI's most prominent statement of intent since the 2018 Charter and arrives as US and European regulators tighten oversight of frontier AI labs.
key_facts.excerpt: The framework is OpenAI's most prominent statement of intent since the 2018 Charter, and arrives as U.S. and European regulators tighten oversight of frontier AI labs.

key_facts.fact: Altman writes 'We deserve an enormous amount of scrutiny given the weight of what we are doing' and commits to resisting AI technology that consolidates power 'in the hands of the few.'
key_facts.excerpt: Chief executive Sam Altman wrote in the post that the lab will 'resist the potential of this technology to consolidate power in the hands of the few.'

key_facts.fact: The post revisits OpenAI's 2019 decision to delay GPT-2 weights, calling the worry 'misplaced' but crediting it with discovering the iterative deployment strategy the company uses today.
key_facts.excerpt: The post revisits OpenAI's 2019 decision to delay the GPT-2 model weights, calling the worry 'misplaced' but crediting the episode with the discovery of iterative deployment, the company's default release strategy ever since.

OpenAI's five new principles reframe its mission from AGI lab to AI infrastructure for humanity

stories.headline: Kuo: OpenAI Working With MediaTek and Qualcomm on AI Smartphone Chips for 2028 Launch

key_facts.fact: Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo reports OpenAI is working with MediaTek and Qualcomm to develop smartphone processors for an AI-focused phone, with mass production expected in 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo claimed on Twitter that OpenAI is working with MediaTek and Qualcomm to create smartphone processors as part of its plan for an AI phone. Mass production is tipped to take place in 2028.

key_facts.fact: Key processor design considerations include power consumption, memory hierarchy management, and basic small-model execution, with complex tasks handled by cloud AI.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Power consumption, memory hierarchy management, and basic small-model execution will be key processor design considerations,' the analyst was quoted as saying. Much like today's top Android phones, Kuo says more complex/demanding tasks will be handled by cloud AI.

key_facts.fact: Chip specs and suppliers are expected to be finalized in late 2026 or Q1 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The analyst says we should expect finalized specs and suppliers in late 2026 or Q1 next year.

key_facts.fact: Chinese supplier Luxshare will be the exclusive system co-design and manufacturing partner for the phone.
key_facts.excerpt: Kuo says Chinese supplier Luxshare and Foxconn rival will be the exclusive 'system co-design and manufacturing partner.'

key_facts.fact: The phone would need to 'continuously' understand user context, suggesting extensive always-on AI functionality.
key_facts.excerpt: Kuo also hints that the future phone would need to 'continuously' understand user context. So I wouldn't be surprised if the OpenAI chipset has extensive always-on functionality.

stories.headline: Musk vs Altman Trial Begins: Jury Selection Starts in Oakland Over OpenAI's Nonprofit Origins

key_facts.fact: Jury selection began Monday in Oakland federal court for Elon Musk's civil trial against Sam Altman and others over OpenAI's transformation from a nonprofit, expected to last several weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: Jury selection in the civil trial filed by Elon Musk against Sam Altman and other OpenAI-related defendants is scheduled to begin on Monday in a federal courthouse in Oakland, California, with the trial expected to last several weeks.

key_facts.fact: U.S. District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers dismissed Musk's fraud claims at his request but allowed breach-of-charitable-trust and unjust-enrichment claims to proceed.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers issued a ruling on April 24 that dismissed Musk's fraud and constructive fraud claims at Musk's request while permitting breach-of-charitable-trust and unjust-enrichment claims to proceed.

key_facts.fact: Musk has sought damages of approximately $150 billion according to Reuters, with The Guardian citing a $134 billion estimate.
key_facts.excerpt: Musk has sought very large damages, with Reuters reporting a $150 billion figure according to a person involved in the case and The Guardian citing a $134 billion estimate.

key_facts.fact: Unsealed court filings include private emails, texts, and diary entries from Musk, Altman, and other Silicon Valley participants.
key_facts.excerpt: Court filings unsealed and reported by The Washington Post and other outlets include private emails, texts and diary entries from Musk, Altman and other Silicon Valley participants.

key_facts.fact: The lawsuit alleges OpenAI's shift from nonprofit to for-profit violated founding commitments; Microsoft is named as a major investor.
key_facts.excerpt: The lawsuit, originally filed in 2024, alleges that OpenAI's shift from a nonprofit structure toward a for-profit model violated founding commitments... Microsoft is repeatedly identified in press coverage as a major investor in OpenAI.

stories.headline: Chinese GPU Maker Moore Threads Swings to Q1 Profit, Revenue Up 155% YoY to $107M

key_facts.fact: Moore Threads reported Q1 2026 revenue of RMB 738 million (~$107M), up 155.35% year-over-year, swinging to a net profit of RMB 29 million (~$4.3M) from a net loss of ~$16.5M a year earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: Pandaily reports Q1 2026 revenue of RMB 738 million, up 155.35% year-over-year, and that net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 29 million in Q1.

key_facts.fact: Full-year 2025 revenue reached RMB 1.505 billion, up 243.37% YoY, with a gross margin of 65.57%.
key_facts.excerpt: Moore Threads released its 2025 annual report and Q1 2026 results, reporting 2025 revenue of RMB 1.505 billion, up 243.37% year-over-year, and a 2025 gross profit of RMB 987 million with a 65.57% gross margin.

key_facts.fact: The company secured a RMB 660 million (~$96M) order for a KUAE intelligent computing cluster in March 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Pandaily also reports a RMB 660 million order for the KUAE intelligent computing cluster in March 2026.

key_facts.fact: R&D spending reached RMB 1.305 billion in 2025, equal to 86.68% of revenue, with 2,014 IP applications filed including 1,743 invention patents.
key_facts.excerpt: R&D expenditure of RMB 1.305 billion in 2025... Moore Threads has filed 2,014 intellectual property applications by end-2025, including 1,743 invention patents, and secured 806 IP rights.

key_facts.fact: Shares surged on Monday following the results as the company advances its 100,000-GPU cluster development.
key_facts.excerpt: Beijing-based GPU maker turns a corner in the first quarter of 2026 after posting a US$16.5 million loss a year earlier.

stories.headline: Meta Signs Deal With Overview Energy for 1GW of Space Solar Power for AI Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Meta signed a first-of-its-kind agreement with Overview Energy for up to 1GW of space solar energy capacity, with orbital demonstration in 2028 and commercial power delivery expected in 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: Overview Energy and Meta today announced a first-of-its-kind agreement and partnership to advance American-built space solar energy with initial orbital demonstration in 2028 and commercial power delivery expected in 2030.

key_facts.fact: Overview's system collects solar energy via satellites in geosynchronous orbit and beams it as low-intensity near-infrared light to existing solar facilities on the ground, enabling around-the-clock power.
key_facts.excerpt: The system collects solar energy in space and beams it to existing solar facilities on the ground, where it is converted into electricity, allowing these assets to maximize utilization and produce power around-the-clock.

key_facts.fact: The beam is invisible, less intense than sunlight, and passively safe for humans, animals, and aircraft according to Overview.
key_facts.excerpt: Overview's beam is invisible, less intense than sunlight, and passively safe for humans, animals, and aircraft.

key_facts.fact: Meta is one of the first major companies to secure rights for future space solar energy capacity; the deal is positioned as strengthening America's energy leadership.
key_facts.excerpt: With this capacity reservation agreement, Meta is one of the first major companies to secure rights for future space solar energy capacity delivered from orbit to the grid.

key_facts.fact: Overview's advisory board includes former NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine, former NASA Administrator Mike Griffin, and former FERC Chairman Joseph Kelliher.
key_facts.excerpt: Overview's advisory board includes Jim Bridenstine, former NASA Administrator and Congressman; Mike Griffin, former NASA Administrator; and Joseph Kelliher, former FERC Chairman and EVP of Regulatory at NextEra.

sources.title: Overview Energy and Meta Announce First-of-Its-Kind Agreement to Bring Space Solar Energy to Data Centers
Meta Seeks to Power Data Centers With Energy Beamed From Space

stories.headline: German AI Robotics Startup Sereact Raises $110M Series B Led by Headline

key_facts.fact: Sereact raised $110 million in a Series B round led by Headline, with new investors including Bullhound Capital, Felix Capital, and Daphni alongside existing backers.
key_facts.excerpt: The Series B funding round was led by venture capital firm Headline, with other new investors including Bullhound Capital, Felix Capital and Daphni, alongside several existing backers.

key_facts.fact: Sereact develops hardware-agnostic Vision Language Action Models (VLAM) that enable robots to understand and adapt to environments in real-time without complex programming.
key_facts.excerpt: Our groundbreaking Vision Language Action Models (VLAM) empower robots to understand and adapt to their environments in real-time – without the need for complex programming.

key_facts.fact: Founded in Stuttgart in 2021, Sereact's customers include Daimler Truck, Bol, MS Direct, and Active Ants.
key_facts.excerpt: Our AI-powered robots are already making an impact across industries, with customers including Daimler Truck, Bol, MS Direct and Active Ants.

key_facts.fact: The company takes a software-first approach, making robots function as intelligent adaptable agents rather than pre-programmed machines, with plans to expand into mobile robots and humanoids.
key_facts.excerpt: Sereact is leading with a software-first approach, enabling robots to function as intelligent, adaptable agents rather than pre-programmed machines... Expanding R&D efforts to support additional robotic platforms, including mobile robots and humanoids.

key_facts.fact: The company declined to disclose its valuation; the funding will support US expansion and development of AI for more complex tasks beyond logistics.
key_facts.excerpt: The company declined to disclose its valuation.

sources.title: AI Startup Sereact Raises $110 Million for Robots That Predict Consequences
